moduleEquations.RegolithRover:
RegolithOut = min(RegolithIn, RoverCapacity)
TravelTime = Distance * hoursPerKm
EnergyConsumed = Distance * CargoMass * energyPerKmPerKg
moduleEquations.ISRUPlant:
LOXOut = RegolithIn * conversionEfficiency
ProcessingTime = RegolithIn / processingRate
BeneficiatedIlmenite = RegolithIn * ilmeniteRecoveryFraction * regHeadGrade
BeneficiatedRegolith = BeneficiatedIlmenite / (beneficiationRegolithMultiplier * regHeadGrade)
GangueMass = RegolithIn - BeneficiatedRegolith
WaterMass = BeneficiatedIlmenite * waterRecoveryFraction * waterMolarMass / ilmeniteMolarMass
OxygenMass = WaterMass * oxygenMolarMass / (2 * waterMolarMass)
ExcavationEnergy = excavationEnergyCoeff * RegolithIn
TransportEnergy = transportEnergyCoeff * RegolithIn * transportDist
BeneficiationEnergy = RegolithIn * lunarGravity * liftHeight / joulesPerKWh + GangueMass * gangueTransportEnergyCoeff * gangueTransportDist
ReactorEnergy = reactorEnergyCoeff * BeneficiatedRegolith
ElectrolysisEnergy = electrolysisEnergyCoeff * WaterMass
LiquefactionEnergy = liquefactionEnergyCoeff * OxygenMass
EnergyConsumed = ExcavationEnergy + TransportEnergy + BeneficiationEnergy + ReactorEnergy + ElectrolysisEnergy + LiquefactionEnergy
moduleEquations.LOXRover:
LOXOut = min(LOXIn, RoverCapacity)
TravelTime = Distance * hoursPerKm
EnergyConsumed = Distance * CargoMass * energyPerKmPerKg
